caption: The drawing is a colored plan view of a landscaped property, predominantly filled with green rectangular sections representing fields or lawns. The upper right section contains a grassy area with scattered trees featuring green, yellow, and orange foliage. At the top center and left, there are two rectangular gray structures adjacent to a curving pale gray path which leads to a central space with multiple smaller connected gray rectangles. To the right of these structures is a formal garden divided into four quadrants, bordered by dark green lines. Each quadrant is filled with parallel rows of plants or flowers in colors of pink, yellow, orange, and red, arranged in a symmetrical pattern, with a small circular area in the center. The entire garden is surrounded by a thick, green perimeter. A driveway, shaded in light gray, extends horizontally across the lower central area, intersected by regularly spaced trees with orange foliage on either side, creating lines and rows that separate the green fields. The fields themselves are shaded in varying tones of green and yellow, with some featuring narrow parallel green lines to indicate planting rows or mowing patterns. The borders of the property, as well as the separations between distinct sections, are marked by rows of similarly colored trees with orange and red foliage, as well as dark green hedgerows.
title: Rutgers Estate and Garden
